class.name: IfcRelAssociatesLibrary
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship ( IfcRelAssociatesLibrary ) handles the assignment of a library item (items of the select IfcLibrarySelect ) to subtypes of IfcObjectDefinition or IfcPropertyDefinition . The relationship is used to assign a library reference or a more detailed link to a library information to objects, property sets or types. A single library reference can be applied to multiple items.

members.member: Reference to a library, from which the definition of the property set is taken.
